objective: Test whether a parameter-free evidence-dominance gate can retain the exact V3.2.4 minimum-boundary projection while improving time/group LogLoss stability on a completely separate secondary-league cohort. This is not a model upgrade and does not extrapolate the Big-5 V3 model to external leagues.

rule.name: EVIDENCE_DOMINANCE_REVERSAL_MARGIN
rule.baseline_probability: normalize reciprocal opening average odds AvgH/AvgD/AvgA
rule.closing_signal: normalize reciprocal closing average odds AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA
rule.interpretation: The fresh closing direction must reverse the original incumbent-target gap by at least the size of the original opening gap. Equality is allowed. No fitted scalar, percentile, TV threshold or learned selector exists.
rule.on_evidence_dominance_true: apply exact frozen V3.2.4 deterministic minimum-L2 Top1 boundary projection toward target
rule.weak_side: argmin opening home-vs-away probability only; draw is never weak side
rule.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening-probability fallback

fresh_data.freshness_guard: selected league-code set must be disjoint from prior_external_stress_codes; no selected-cohort result labels or metric outcomes were read before this contract commit
fresh_data.selection_basis: secondary-division identity and source family only; not selected by result labels, odds movement performance, LogLoss, Brier, RPS or Top1 outcomes

evaluation.secondary_reference: ungated exact V3.2.4 projection on the same fresh cohort, descriptive only and never used to change the frozen rule
evaluation.fold_construction: sort all completed usable rows by match date then deterministic league/home/away tie-break; split into 12 contiguous equal-count folds before reading metric results

terminal_classification.EVIDENCE_DOMINANCE_EXTERNALLY_STABLE: candidate global LL/Brier/RPS nondegrade and Top1 nondegrade versus opening baseline; chronological fold LL nondegrade >=10/12; league-season LL nondegrade >=10/12
terminal_classification.EVIDENCE_DOMINANCE_EXTERNALLY_MIXED: candidate global LL/Brier/RPS and Top1 all nondegrade versus opening baseline, but either LL stability count is 7-9/12
terminal_classification.EVIDENCE_DOMINANCE_EXTERNALLY_FAILED: candidate global LogLoss degrades versus opening baseline OR either LL stability count <=6/12 OR any frozen-rule/inventory/freshness guard fails

interpretation_guards: No value from the parent external stress cohort may change this frozen rule after this commit.
No fresh-cohort result may change the rule, cohort, threshold, selector, projection or evaluation gate after first download.
Closing odds remain an external diagnostic signal only and are not added to Football3 production inputs.
This fresh external validation cannot promote Formal V2, V3.1.1, V3.2.4 or Stage7.
If stable, the result is evidence for a future separately governed research candidate only; prediction_weight remains zero.
